description: This file contains Go source code for handling email notifications in the Mattermost server, including functions for processing message attachments, generating notification messages, and hyperlinking channels within email content.

classes.name: FieldRow
classes.description: Represents a row of message attachment fields, containing multiple cells.

classes.name: EmailMessageAttachment
classes.description: Represents an email message attachment with pretext, text, and fields.

methods.name: GetMessageForNotification
methods.description: Generates a notification message for email based on a post, team, and site URL.

methods.name: ProcessMessageAttachments
methods.description: Processes post attachments into email message attachments with formatted fields.

methods.name: prepareTextForEmail
methods.description: Converts plain text into HTML suitable for email, escaping and converting markdown.

methods.name: prepareNotificationMessageForEmail
methods.description: Prepares a notification message for email, converting markdown and adding hyperlinks.

methods.name: GenerateHyperlinkForChannels
methods.description: Replaces channel mentions in a message with hyperlinks to channels.
